description: This file declares functions related to graphics configuration and detection in the Cuttlefish Android virtualization project. It includes function prototypes for checking graphics availability and configuring GPU settings, with relevant includes and namespace encapsulation.

methods.name: GetGraphicsAvailabilityWithSubprocessCheck
methods.description: Checks the current graphics availability status, possibly involving a subprocess check.

methods.name: ConfigureGpuSettings
methods.description: Configures GPU settings based on graphics availability, GPU mode, renderer features, and guest configuration.
